_comment: The emulator suite, bound so a physical phone on the same Wi-Fi can reach it.
A copy of firebase.json's emulator block with one difference: host 0.0.0.0
instead of the default 127.0.0.1. The default is correct for everything that
runs on this machine and useless for a device, which sees loopback as itself.
A separate file rather than an edit to firebase.json, following the
firebase.invitation-test.json precedent: the checked-in default should stay
the safe one, and binding an unauthenticated emulator to every interface is
not a thing to turn on for everybody by default.
firebase-tools 13 rather than 15 because 15 requires JDK 21 and this machine
